title: AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.21586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. translated_title: AVALON：基于人类种子拓扑记忆的零样本室内导航
translated_abstract: 室内服务机器人常常需要进入未经建图的建筑，而这些建筑的布局和任务约束对用户而言早已熟悉。我们针对这种“人类熟悉、机器人未见”的场景提出了AVALON，这是一个围绕人类种子分层空间记忆、节点验证拓扑执行，以及任务触发、证据门控的人机记忆协同更新而构建的拓扑导航框架。机器人无需事先进行现场遍历或针对特定场地的训练。部署时只需要一张平面图、地点线索和初始的拓扑-里程计对齐。视觉深度点目标导航利用经过验证的节点到达来执行平移重锚定，无需机器人构建的全局SLAM地图。人机记忆协同更新融合了互补的信息来源：人类操作者可以指定无法通过视觉观测到的任务约束，并报告离线的环境变更，而机器人则提供物理状态的证据……
tldr: AVALON提出了一种零样本室内导航框架，机器人无需实地遍历或SLAM建图，仅凭平面图、地点线索和人机记忆协同更新即可在从未见过的熟悉建筑中完成拓扑导航。
en_tdlr: AVALON is a zero-shot indoor navigation framework that enables robots to navigate unseen buildings using only floor plans and place clues, leveraging human-seeded topological memory and human-robot memory co-updating without requiring on-site traversal or SLAM map construction.
